Introduction

About Me

I’m an AI/ML engineer with 4 years of experience building and operationalizing large language model (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and production-grade ML systems. My work spans deep learning, generative AI, NLP, computer vision, and MLOps — with end-to-end ownership of systems built on PyTorch, TensorFlow, AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, and Databricks. I’ve designed distributed ML infrastructure at millions-of-events scale, applied responsible AI and model governance in regulated environments, and driven measurable reductions in operational cost and analyst effort.
